sources.note: Yamaha DBR15/DBR12/DBR10 technical specifications (opened, rendered): DBR12 dimensions W x H x D 376 x 601 x 348 mm with rubber feet, net weight 15.8 kg, floor monitor angle 50 degrees symmetrical, plastic, handles side x 2, pole socket 35 mm. Page 2 'Dimensions' carries the DBR12 rear view with the amplifier panel. Positions are read from that drawing at 1.19 px/mm (the 376 mm width spans 448 px; the 102 mm M8 point dimension gives 1.22 px/mm), x from the cabinet centre line, y from the base (601 mm tall): in-line = CH1 combo jack (top jack, the one next to the MIC/LINE switch), link-out = the XLR output jack below the two combos, power-in = IEC inlet, power = rocker beside it. Expect +/- 3 mm. The drawing is a line drawing, not a dimensioned panel layout, so the coordinates are a scaled reading, not printed numbers.

Yamaha DBR owner's manual (opened, text read): rear panel legend: 1 input jacks CH1/CH2 (balanced combo XLR/phone, RCA on CH2), 2 LEVEL knobs, 3 MIC/LINE switch for CH1, 4 output switch THRU/MIX, 5 output jack (balanced XLR, for another DBR), power switch and AC inlet at the bottom of the panel.
Yamaha DBR series specs page (opened): DBR12 W 376 mm, H 601 mm, D 348 mm (the three columns are DBR15 / DBR12 / DBR10: 455 / 376 / 308 wide, 700 / 601 / 493 high, 378 / 348 / 289 deep).

Neutrik NC3MD-L-1 product page (opened): "Standardized D sized 24 mm panel cutout". openingMm = 24 for the XLR ports by that convention (guess: the drawing shows the connector rings about 21 mm across).

Yamaha DBR12 side-left photo (2500 x 4360 px, opened, silhouette profiled row by row): the cabinet is 2271 px deep for 348 mm (6.5 px/mm), and its rear edge is 28 mm shallower in the waist (the handle zone, 190 to 540 mm above the base) than at the top and bottom lobes, which the extruded plan does not follow (the picture does: the notch is filled with the body colour and the handle recess is painted). The front photo gives the top corners: 19 mm inset at the very top, full width 36 mm lower (edgeRadiusMm 20, edgeDropMm 30). The three pictures are the real front (113,180,2273,3618), rear (454,105,1092,1789) and side (114,198,2271,3963) photos with the white corners filled (--project-photo ...,fill). The plan (front 376 mm, 330 mm wide 250 mm behind the baffle, rear polygon 200 mm, corner radii 24 / auto / 40 mm) is an estimate from the 3/4 photos; the two rubber feet and the side handle recesses are not modelled.
